plainText:
Olivia's Lycanroc (Japanese: ライチのルガルガン Lychee's Lugarugan) is a owned by Olivia in the , , and . In the animated series, Olivia owns a Midday Form Lycanroc, while in the games and in Pokémon Adventures, she owns a Midnight Form Lycanroc.

==In animation==
===Pokémon the Series===
====History====
=====Pre-series=====
When was still a , it ran away from Olivia and evolved into Lycanroc before returning to her. Later, Lycanroc was used in Olivia's against and his , where it was defeated, earning Kiawe his grandfather's Z-Ring and Firium Z.

===== =====
 
Lycanroc debuted in The Island Whisperer! to help Kiawe's Charizard when it was struggling to deal with an out of control . Lycanroc quickly calms the Wild Bull Pokémon down. It is later seen getting acquainted with Ash's Rockruff. Afterwards, it helps fend off a . 

In Trials and Determinations!, Lycanroc was used during Olivia's grand trial battle against , where it teamed up with to battle Ash's Rockruff and . Despite proving to be a formidable opponent with its strength and speed, Lycanroc was eventually defeated by Rockruff's .

In Rising from the Ruins!, after hearing about Rockruff's disappearance, Lycanroc left its to go and find him. It eventually met up with Gladion's Lycanroc and took Rockruff to the Ruins of Life, where they encountered , who attacked them. Lycanroc later watched as Rockruff evolved into a . Afterwards, Lycanroc went back to Olivia.

In The Professors' New Adventure!, Lycanroc attended the wedding of and with Olivia.

Lycanroc reappeared in Some Kind of Laziness! and Not Caving Under Pressure!, during flashbacks.

In Securing the Future!, Lycanroc joined the rest of Alola in showering with light so it could return to its . After it returned to its true form, it and Olivia used their Z-Move to shower Necrozma in a blinding amount of light.

In Heart of Fire! Heart of Stone!, Olivia used Lycanroc in her battle against . It went up against , but the battle was interrupted when attempted to steal the Pokémon. Lycanroc was able to stop them when Brock and Olivia teamed up, allowing Lycanroc to use a heart-shaped against them.

In Z-Move Showdown!, Lycanroc was used to battle a to prevent it from the destroying the Manalo Stadium. With a combination of Z-Moves, Lycanroc, among the other island kahunas' Pokémon, managed to send the Guzzlord back into its Ultra Wormhole.

====Personality and characteristics====
Lycanroc is depicted as a caring Pokémon. For example, in Rising from the Ruins!, it left its Trainer on its own accord to help Ash's Rockruff and defend it from .

===GOTCHA!===
Olivia's Lycanroc briefly appeared in GOTCHA!.

==In the games==
Olivia's Lycanroc appears in , where it participates in all of Olivia's battles.

===In the core series===
 
 
 
 
 
 

===In spin-off games===
====Pokémon Masters EX====
 
Olivia's Lycanroc appears alongside Olivia as a sync pair.

 
 

==In the manga==
 
===Pokémon Adventures===
In Pokémon Move Specialist Professor Kukui, Olivia used her Lycanroc in a practice battle against Nanu's . When Olivia became agitated by Nanu's taunts, both Trainers attempted to use their respective Z-Moves, only to be stopped by Hala, who didn't want them to damage the stage they were battling on.

====Moves used====
 
 
 

In Pokémon Move Specialist Professor Kukui, was mentioned to be able to use , but the move was interrupted before it could be executed. This also implies it knows a attack.
